## Deck Goal
Teach frontend-oriented AEM developers how content policies govern component capability by template context, how Allowed Components and policy defaults shape authoring, and how the Style System connects semantic author choices to deployed CSS.

## Required Background
{
  "deck_context": {
    "source_summary": "Class 7 of a seven-week AEM Sites course, delivered Tuesday, August 25, 2026. The audience understands JCR Resources, Sling request resolution and editable-template structure versus initial content. This class completes the technical foundation for the individual Week 2 Guide Page authoring practice.",
    "core_claim": "A safe AEM authoring contract combines reusable component code with narrowly scoped content policies, explicit container permissions and a small set of semantic styles whose CSS is deployed and tested.",
    "canonical_facts": [
      "Component code defines technical capability; a content policy configures capability for a template context.",
      "Policy mappings for editable-template component locations are stored below /conf/<site>/settings/wcm/templates/<template>/policies/jcr:content.",
      "The cq:policy property holds a relative reference to a policy definition below /conf/<site>/settings/wcm/policies.",
      "A layout container policy determines which components authors may insert in that container.",
      "Policy defaults configure a reusable context; dialog values are authored on individual component instances below /content.",
      "The Style System maps author-facing style names to CSS classes configured in a content policy.",
      "Developers implement style classes in deployed client libraries; AEM applies selected classes to the component decoration wrapper."
    ],
    "canonical_terms": [
      "content policy",
      "cq:policy",
      "Allowed Components",
      "policy defaults",
      "authored instance values",
      "Style System",
      "Style Name",
      "CSS Classes",
      "client library",
      "decoration wrapper",
      "/conf",
      "/content"
    ]
  },
  "slide_local_context": {
    "required_background": "The Guide Page main container allows Title, Text and Image. An unrelated Carousel is installed but unavailable in this container. Show the component browser result as policy evidence, not a rendering result."
